_comment: How to edit the narrative map: this file is the ONLY place to change which coin belongs to which narrative category on /api/narrative/history and the /narrative page. Add, remove or move a coin by editing the "map" object below: keys are UPPERCASE ticker symbols, values are a category id from api/data/narrative_categories.json (ai, rwa, l2s, memecoins, or any seed you add there). No code change and no restart needed: the API re-reads this file when it changes on disk. Invalid entries (lowercase symbol, unknown category id) are skipped with a logged warning; the rest still load. BTC -> store-of-value is a grandfathered legacy entry (not a seed). This file does NOT affect /api/narrative/categories or /screener, which stay on the frozen legacy map in api/analytics/narrative/mapping.py (option B, approved 2026-09-24).
